description: Variation of Conditions 2 (Approved Plans), 7 (Refuse), 39 (District Heating Network) and 45 (Substation Details) attached to planning permission P/2052/20 dated 19/11/2021 to allow internal and external alterations, including amendments to address fire safety and energy strategy requirements, amendments to the brick bond, increased parapet heights to private terraces, installation of external rainwater fittings, submission of refuse and substation details, and removal of the requirement to connect to a District Heating Network
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the hard and soft landscaping details submitted and approved
under PL/0802/24 dated 30/09/2024 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed
in writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby
permitted shall be constructed to include 90 per cent of the new homes to meet
Building Regulations requirement Part M M4(2) 'accessible and adaptable
dwellings' with the remaining 10 per cent meeting Building Regulations
requirement Part M M4(3) 'wheelchair user dwellings' and thereafter retained in
that form.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">All
development shall<span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;color:#333333;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB"> </span>take place in accordance with the Demolition and Construction
Logistics Plan Rev 04 and details submitted and approved under application
P/3450/22 dated 19/12/2022 unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local
planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Phasing Strategy details submitted and approved under
application P/3448/22 dated 14/11/2022, unless otherwise agreed in writing by
the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Surface and Foul Water Disposal details submitted and
approved under PL/0394/23 dated 30/11/2023 and retained as such unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding the
provisions of Part 16 (Communications) to Schedule 2 of the Town and Country
Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any order revoking and
replacing that Order with or without modification, no development that would otherwise
be permitted by that part of the Order (or the equivalent provisions of any
replacement Order) shall be carried out without planning permission having
first been obtained by the local planning authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) details
submitted and approved under P/3451/22 dated 19-10-2022, unless otherwise
agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Other than those shown on
the approved drawings, no soil stacks, soil vent pipes, flues, ductwork or any
other pipework shall be fixed to the elevations of the building hereby
approved.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented, for
the duration of the construction period, in accordance with the construction
management strategy and associated details submitted and approved under
P/1908/23 dated 14/09/2023, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local
planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Surface Water Attenuation details submitted and approved
under PL/0394/23 dated 30/11/2023 and retained as such, unless otherwise agreed
in writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The substation shall be
constructed and installed in full accordance with the substation details shown
on the approved plans and documents forming part of this permission and shall
thereafter be retained and maintained in accordance with those details for the
lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the interim refuse details for each relevant building, plot or
phase, as submitted and approved under P/3452/22 dated 19/12/2022 relating to
Condition 7(a), and retained as such during the construction of the
development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Permeable Paving details submitted and approved under
PL/0394/23 dated 30/11/2023 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in
writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Emergency Planning details submitted and approved under
PL/0394/23 dated 30/11/2023 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in
writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
refuse and recycling containers shall be provided in the numbers and
configuration shown within the waste details hereby approved and shall be
provided prior to the first occupation of the relevant building, plot or phase
(whichever is relevant). The refuse and recycling facilities shall thereafter
be retained and managed in accordance with the approved Waste Management
Strategy for the lifetime of the development.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the Circular Economy Statement and details submitted and
approved under P/3453/22 dated 24/11/2022 and retained as such unless otherwise
agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the details relating to protection of the piped watercourse
submitted and approved under PL/0394/23 dated 30/11/2023 and retained as such
unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the levels details submitted and approved under PL/0442/23
dated 30/11/2023 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the
local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the details relating to the Air Source Heat Pump and Revised
Energy Strategy submitted and approved under PL/0655/23 dated 31/01/2024 and
retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Within
3 months (or other such period agreed in writing by the local planning
authority) of the final completion of the development a post construction
assessment shall be undertaken demonstrating compliance with the approved
Energy Statement; which thereafter shall be submitted to the local planning
authority for written approval.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior
to occupation or use of the site, the LPA will be provided with clear and
obvious proof that the details of the Aboricultural Impact Assessment (Prepared
by PJC, dated 9 June 2020) have been adhered to, either through separate
reports or single larger report, summarising details of each clerk of works
visit and including (where relevant) photographic evidence of adherence to the
aforementioned report and Tree Protection Plan. This condition may only be
discharged on completion of the development, subject to satisfactory evidence
of compliance through contemporaneous monitoring of tree protection throughout
construction, by the appointed specialist.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance
with the fire safety details submitted and approved under PL/0778/24 dated 12/11/2024
and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the materials details submitted and approved under PL/0779/24
dated 17/10/2024 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the
local planning authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance
with the window section details submitted and approved under PL/0779/24 dated 17/10/2024
and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<font color="#333333" face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding the
approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the play space details submitted and approved under PL/0802/24
dated 30/09/2024 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the
local planning authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding the
approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the green roof/ photo-voltaic panel details submitted and
approved under PL/0802/24 dated 30/09/2024 and retained as such unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The communal facilities for
television reception shall be provided and maintained in full accordance with
the details approved under application reference PL/0753/26 dated 30 April 2026
and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. No
additional television reception equipment, including aerials, dishes or other
such equipment, shall be installed on the walls or roofs of the buildings other
than in accordance with the approved details without the prior written approval
of the Local Planning Authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->The development hereby
approved in relation to each building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant)
shall not be first occupied until a verification report demonstrating
completion of the works set out in the approved Geo-Environmental &amp;
Geotechnical Assessment (Ground) Investigation) Report (Prepared by JOMAS
Engineering Environmental), and the effectiveness of the remediation shall be
submitted to and approved, in writing, by the local planning authority. The
report shall include results of sampling and monitoring carried out in
accordance with the approved verification plan to demonstrate that the site
remediation criteria have been met. It shall also include any plan (a
'long-term monitoring and maintenance plan') for longer-term monitoring of
pollutant linkages, maintenance and arrangements for contingency action, as
identified in the verification plan, and for the reporting of this to the local
planning authority. The long-term monitoring and maintenance plan shall be
implemented as approved. A verification report is only required to be submitted
and approved once per phase.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->If, during development,
contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then
no further construction of that building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant)
of the development (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning
authority) shall be carried out until the developer has submitted a remediation
strategy to the local planning authority detailing how this unanticipated
contamination is to be dealt with and obtained written approval from the local
planning authority. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The relevant building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant), including
associated car park access and ancillary facilities, shall not be occupied
until the audio-visual access control system approved under application
reference PL/2681/25, dated 23 April 2026, has been fully installed and made
operational. The approved system shall thereafter be retained and maintained
for the lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The guidance information
for occupants on minimising dwelling overheating risk in accordance with the
cooling hierarchy, as approved under application reference PL/2831/25 dated 26
March 2026, shall be provided to the occupants of each relevant residential
unit prior to its first occupation.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby
approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the Water Strategy
approved under application reference PL/2455/25 dated 20 November 2025,
demonstrating that mains water consumption shall not exceed 105 litres per
person per day. The approved measures shall be implemented prior to the first
occupation of the relevant building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant) and
shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby
approved shall be implemented in accordance with the air quality assessment and
mitigation details submitted and approved under PL/2681/25 dated 23/04/2026,
and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby
approved, shall not be occupied until details of the lighting (full
specification, elevations and location) of all public realm and other external
areas (including buildings, the podium car park/garden and key entrance /
access points namely between the site and Grange Farm redevelopment site)
within the site has been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local
planning authority. The details shall include details of the intensity of light
emissions (including the surface area to be illuminated), light spillage,
specification and detailed drawings of the proposed lighting columns and
fittings and any measures for mitigating the effects of light pollution. The
exterior lighting would need to take account of any biodiversity
recommendations or requirements, such as bat friendly lighting. The development
shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be
retained as such thereafter.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The hard landscaping shall
be carried out in full accordance with the details approved under application
reference PL/0339/26 dated 26 March 2026, prior to the occupation of any part
of the development, or in accordance with the implementation programme approved
under that application. All soft landscaping works, including planting, seeding
or turfing comprised within the approved landscaping scheme, shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved details no later than the first planting
and seeding season following the final occupation of the residential parts of
the buildings or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.
Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of five years from
completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged,
diseased or defective shall be replaced during the next planting season with
others of a similar size and species, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the
Local Planning Authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The hard and soft
landscaping within the development shall be managed and maintained in full
accordance with the Landscape Management Plan and Landscape Maintenance Plan
approved under application reference PL/2454/25 dated 26 March 2026, including
the approved management responsibilities, maintenance schedules, management
programme, monitoring arrangements and provisions for communal residential
areas, green roofs and blue infrastructure. The approved management and
maintenance measures shall be carried out in accordance with the approved
timescales and shall thereafter continue to be implemented for the lifetime of
the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Evidence of certification
of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the
Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any part of the
development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and
operated in accordance with any approval.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development shall be
operated in full accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan, including the
Refuse Management Strategy, approved under application reference PL/0252/26
dated 26 March 2026. The approved measures shall be implemented, retained and
complied with for the lifetime of the development, and all deliveries and
servicing associated with the development shall be undertaken only in
accordance with the approved details.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development shall be operated in full accordance with the Parking
Management Plan approved under application reference PL/2909/25 dated 02 June
2026, including the approved arrangements for the management of parking spaces,
active and passive electric vehicle charging provision, Blue Badge parking and
cycle parking for residential and non-residential users and visitors. The
approved arrangements and facilities shall be implemented, retained and
maintained in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the
development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The arrangements for the
distribution of mail and other deliveries to residents within the development
shall be provided and operated in full accordance with the details approved
under application reference PL/2614/25 dated 28 April 2026. The approved
arrangements shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of
the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to the occupation of
the development, a Post Completion Report setting out the predicted and actual performance
against all numerical targets in the relevant Circular Economy Statement shall
be submitted to the GLA at: CircularEconomyLPG@london.gov.uk, along with any
supporting evidence as per the GLA's Circular Economy Statement Guidance. The
Post Completion Report shall provide updated versions of Tables 1 and 2 of the
Circular Economy Statement, the Recycling and Waste Reporting form and Bill of
Materials. Confirmation of submission to the GLA shall be submitted to, and
approved in writing by, the local planning authority, prior to occupation<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development shall be
undertaken in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy (Prepared by JAW,
dated 21 September 2021). Within 3 months (or other such period agreed in
writing by the local planning authority) of the final completion of the
development a post construction assessment shall be undertaken and
demonstrating compliance with the approved Energy Statement; which thereafter
shall be submitted to the local planning authority for written approval.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Piling or any other
foundation designs using penetrative methods shall not be permitted other than
with the express written consent of the local planning authority, which may be
given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is
no resultant unacceptable risk to groundwater.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Notwithstanding the
approved plans, the development hereby approved shall be implemented in
accordance with the details submitted and approved under PL/0420/23 dated
20/12/2023 and retained as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local
planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>







</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development shall be
carried out in accordance with the approved details.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
